limitations.zh: 局部扫描覆盖；ROI 均值不是组水平解码峰值，也不代表全部面孔身份编码位置。

finding.zh: 协议 1 采用右侧 TPJ 或 hMT/V5+ 的 rTMS 检验下落目标拦截的时间控制。坐标为实际刺激点的组均值。
finding.en: Protocol 1 used right TPJ or hMT/V5+ rTMS to examine interception timing for descending targets. Coordinates summarize the actual stimulation sites.

condition.zh: 协议 1：rTMS 前后比较；自然重力或反重力下落目标；反应时控制任务
condition.en: Protocol 1: before/after rTMS; gravity-consistent or reversed-gravity descent; reaction-time control

sample.zh: 协议 1 共 12 名，TPJ 与 hMT/V5+ 各 6 名；其中 6 名也接受另一靶点刺激
sample.en: Protocol 1: 12 participants, 6 per initial target; 6 also received stimulation of the other target

roiDefinition.zh: 根据既往 fMRI 设置靶点并以个体 MRI 导航；表 1 报告实际刺激位置的 MNI 均值
roiDefinition.en: Targets based on prior fMRI and navigated using individual MRI; Table 1 reports mean actual MNI stimulation positions

direction.zh: 拦截反应提前；TPJ 效应依赖重力一致性，hMT/V5+ 的效应更广
direction.en: Earlier interception responses; TPJ effects depended on gravity consistency, hMT/V5+ effects were broader

limitations.zh: 刺激范围与网络效应不能由单一坐标表示；这些是刺激位置而非 BOLD 激活峰值。区域关联是宏观阅读线索。
limitations.en: Stimulation spread and network effects cannot be represented by a single point. These are stimulation positions, not BOLD peaks; anatomical links are broad reading associations.
